chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy)
subject: cs-10

questions.question: How can technology cause “Social Isolation” for victims of online harassment?

options.B: They may stop joining social activities and feel alone
options.D: They spend all day at the mall

questions.explanation: Option B ('They may stop joining social activities and feel alone') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).

questions.question: One way to prevent cyberbullying is “Parental Involvement,” which means parents should:

options.A: Buy more gadgets for their kids
options.B: Monitor their children’s online activities and set rules
options.D: Ignore what their children do online

questions.explanation: Option B ('Monitor their children’s online activities and set rules') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).

questions.question: The “Digital Divide” refers to the gap between:

options.B: People who have access to technology and those who do not

questions.explanation: Option B ('People who have access to technology and those who do not') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).

questions.question: What is “Access Divide” primarily related to?

options.A: The number of apps on a phone
options.B: Physical infrastructure like broadband and mobile devices
options.D: How many friends a person has

questions.explanation: Option B ('Physical infrastructure like broadband and mobile devices') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).

questions.question: “Digital Literacy” means:

options.A: Being able to read physical books
options.B: Knowing how to use digital tools and the internet properly

questions.explanation: Option B ('Knowing how to use digital tools and the internet properly') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).

questions.question: Why does the digital divide worsen social inequalities?

options.B: It leaves some groups without essential services like online education and healthcare
options.C: It lowers the price of technology
options.D: It increases the number of jobs for everyone

questions.explanation: Option B ('It leaves some groups without essential services like online education and healthcare') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).

questions.question: Affordability is a barrier in the digital divide when:

options.B: Computers and internet services are too expensive for low-income families
options.D: There is too much content available

questions.explanation: Option B ('Computers and internet services are too expensive for low-income families') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).

questions.question: The HTML tag <h1> is used for:
questions.explanation: Option A ('A paragraph') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).

questions.question: What is the binary representation of 10?
questions.explanation: Option A ('1010') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).

questions.question: What is the value of x after x = x * 2 + 3; when x = 4 initially?
questions.explanation: Option B ('11') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).

questions.question: The term "debugging" refers to:
questions.explanation: Option B ('Finding and fixing errors') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).

questions.question: What does the NOT operator ! do in C?
questions.explanation: Option A ('Flips a bit value') is the verified answer according to Federal Board (FBISE) examination standards for FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 04 (Unit 6 & 7: Cyber Ethics & Literacy).
